firstRemoval.guideRequirement: 六色與攻擊時的心四連；攻略未區分首消、既有珠落下連鎖與隨機天降。
firstRemoval.codeFinding: 固定計畫 firstColors=63 額外要求首消六色，比攻略文字嚴格。
firstRemoval.decision: 保留現有保守條件；改善求路導引與停止診斷，不以攻略未提及為由取消原生隊長或心四連限制。

floorDifferences.summary: AppMedia 先進化 Solomon、變身當回合立即攻擊；目前沿用 GameWith 開場，不能混接冷卻順序。
GameWith 六色無四連存一回後攻擊；新雙 log 均已走過本層。
GameWith 用五秒達人多色跳超根性；AppMedia 刻意不觸發並多回合拆盾，屬不同路線。
兩站均 Solomon、Keisy、Atori 兩次攻擊；AppMedia 額外建議指定木吸收敵人。
AppMedia 按 Diena 剩餘冷卻存技；目前保留 GameWith 的固定順序。
兩站均直接攻擊；六色的破防可直接過層，不適合作額外存技點。
兩站仍列兩次攻擊，GameWith 指定 Clammy；r4 額外只依精確原生死亡／半血狀態允許一盤補刀，未推定復活時序。
一般分支 GameWith 一次、AppMedia 兩次攻擊；部位分支三次與四次亦不同，不直接增回合。
一般分支 AppMedia 加光或暗十字處理暗闇目覺；部位分支另提屬吸時 Solomon。
GameWith 一回攻擊；AppMedia 分 Weldor 二至三回、Raguel 後續吸收和 Solomon，不宜只放寬最大回合。
基本流程相同；AppMedia 說 Solomon 未就緒需存技，不授權略過必要技能。
最新版 GameWith 明示可能提早超根性，r4 破盾後每盤讀本體 HP≤50% 即進 Solomon。
最新版 GameWith 改為 Atori→Diena→Riku→Atori，bypass 過期須實際施放 Solomon；r4 另為 AppMedia 的 B14 銜接保留 Keisy。
r4 使用 AppMedia 的第二盤 Keisy 擴盤，避免消耗 B15 開場必要的 Solomon；後段明確查詢 Solomon 就緒後才收尾。
GameWith 新增火／木四連解不可消；求路器未模擬此潛覺時序。r4 採 AppMedia 開場 Solomon＋Riku，確認解除不可消才轉珠；最後 Riku 上限兩盤。

decisions: B7: up to two original attacks with exact native enemy roster; one additional board only for dead 200038 and living 210524 at <=50% HP. Fresh coverage and unchanged enemy/target evidence are required. Full clear can advance directly.
B12: check native body HP <=50% before each of the two remaining attack boards, proceeding directly to Solomon if the threshold was reached early.
B13: hold the Keisy loop until B14; restore uncovered absorption with an actual Solomon cast and native bypass result; finish with Atori, Diena, Riku, Atori in one board.

B14: hold Keisy on the first board, require its native-ready resize on the second, then reserve native-ready Solomon before finishing. This follows AppMedia rather than spending Solomon on B14 resize.

B15: require Solomon for active unmatchable, confirm its removal before planning, then use Riku and Atori. No simulated latent unmatchable recovery is claimed; the final Riku stage remains bounded to two boards including stalls.

Execution history freezes separate native enemy identity/HP/alive/target evidence before search, before release and after the settled acknowledged turn. Generation, turn and battle identity bind the result; cached observations never authorize actions.
New schema keys require the next build containing this source. Delivered 0.5.55 does not accept r4; imported older profiles are never changed automatically.

Single-player, exact native skills, native receipts, bounded gestures and the consumed-run restart restriction remain in force. Damage, survival, cooldown continuity and full device clear are not verified.
limitations: 攻略是策略依據；沒有驗證原生傷害、回復、存活或全程通關。
11-19 雙 log 各為 20 盤／33 技，停在 B7；第二份 completed=41 是累計。新來源尚無裝置紀錄。
只產生資料並作來源／格式審查；已撰寫案例尚未執行，沒有編譯、CI 或打包。
B7 cached action 及 HP 快照支持復活調查，但不足以證明實際事件順序。
